title: Evolution from Chatbots to Autonomous Computer Use

milestones.interaction_model: Text in, text out. The model answers questions inside a web box.
The model emits JSON payloads to call external APIs, but requires human developer orchestration.
First mainstream model taking screenshots and sending virtual mouse clicks and keypresses.
Internal chain of thought enables extended deliberation before action.
Integrated 1.05M context, native terminal/GUI grounding, multi-step autonomous execution without human in the loop.
